Resources

Pricing

Credit pricing for Stability AI API services, including Stable Image, Stable Audio, and 3D models. 1 credit equals $0.01.

Power your applications with the Stability AI API.

How does pricing work?

API usage is based on credits. 1 credit = $0.01.Pricing is subject to change as we improve our models and infrastructure.

Buying credits

Get started with 25 free credits. Check your credit balance and purchase additional credits on your account page.
